status: DIAGNOSTIC; EXACT FOR THE IMPLEMENTED HISTORICAL ASSEMBLY
claim: The historical Möbius-fiber twist assembly has nonzero cross terms and a semi-trivial exceptional family at d=0. This does not prove the desired M1 asymptotic estimate or yet identify the historical assembly with the entire current fourth-moment object.
independent_cpp: src/cpp/m1/cross_term_energy.cpp compiled with C++20 -O2 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic and independently agreed with Python to floating-point precision at N=53 and N=199.
fourier_identity: With Ahat(xi)=sum_d A(d)e_N(-xi d), E=(1/N) sum_xi |sum_tau Ahat_tau(xi)^2|^2. The time- and frequency-domain implementations agree to relative floating-point error about 1e-16.
exact_exception: At d=0, v_0(u)=1 after cancellation. For psi_1=1 and every nontrivial psi_2 in the annihilator group, A_(1,psi_2)(0)=N-2.
